# maatify/login-with-third-party

> 标签: LoginWithThirdPartyHandler, handler, login, maatify, party, php, third

## 简介

Official PHP library for maatify.dev Login With Third Party handler, known by our team

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 5；已收录于 php-v5, php-v7, php-v8。
